# heraut version next

Compute and print the next version without side effects.

Print the tag the next release would create, from the commits since the last tag. Nothing is
written. Use it in CI to know the version before building. Warnings (a major held back or still to
confirm, a shallow clone) go to stderr, so stdout is exactly the tag.

## Usage

```text
heraut version next [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut version next
heraut version next --env staging
heraut version next --pre-release rc
heraut version next --json
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--allow-major` |  | confirm a major bump for this run: lift versioning.bump.stay_at_v0, versioning.bump.confirm_major and the pre-release series major-escalation block |
| `--env <string>` |  | target environment (for per-env strategies) |
| `--force` |  | override safety checks blocking tag promotion or missing PR/MR metadata |
| `--json` |  | print the result as a JSON envelope |
| `--pre-release <string>` |  | mint a pre-release \<core\>-\<label\>.\<N\> (plain semver only; never writes CHANGELOG.md) |
| `--set-build-id <string>` |  | build ID for the tag: the {build} token in tag_format, or +\<id\> build metadata under plain semver (requires --set-version) |
| `--set-version <string>` |  | override the resolved version — with or without tag prefix (e.g. 1.2.3 or v1.2.3); must match the strategy (SemVer, or the CalVer format) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
